SeoContent_P2: Privacy comes from the architecture: the site is a set of static pages, and every tool processes your input inside the browser. Compute-heavy tools such as hashing, encryption, image, PDF and QR processing run in WebAssembly modules compiled from Rust; lighter ones, like the JSON formatter or the text diff, are plain JavaScript. The passwords, keys and files you work with are never uploaded.

SeoContent_P1: MyDevTools is a free collection of browser-based developer utilities: formatters and validators for JSON, XML and YAML, Base64, Hex and URL encoders, hash and HMAC calculators, JWT and X.509 tools, a regex tester, image and PDF utilities, and generators for UUIDs, passwords and QR codes. There is nothing to install and no account to create.
